title: One hit kills in my cyberpunk brawler, so I had to give the player an answer: swing into their swing and you parry it
author: Impressive_Onion1151
selftext:
I've been building a 2D cyberpunk brawler with no health bar at all. One hit ends the run.

That was unplayable until I added the parry — if you swing *into* an enemy's swing, theirs is spent, they stagger, and the opening is yours. It changed how the fights read completely: backing away loses, mashing loses, and the whole thing becomes about commitment.

There's also Focus, which drops the entire world into slow motion for a few seconds — rain, enemies, your own jump arcs. It grants no invulnerability. It just buys you time to read a swing.

**Free demo (Windows):** [**https://shs2002.itch.io/hanabira-demo**](https://shs2002.itch.io/hanabira-demo)

It's vanilla JS on a canvas, no engine — happy to answer anything about how it's built.
